description.value: Northern Shores Lodging and Catering is a hotel and catering operation situated at 455 Beach Road in the North Coast & Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia. Operating in one of the most remote and sparsely serviced stretches of the BC coast, it represents a rare accommodation option for touring cyclists making their way through this area. The combined lodging and catering offering suggests on-site food service may be available.
